text: Pieces (integrations) can be built using TypeScript for a flexible, code-based development process
quote: Build pieces using TypeScript for a more powerful and flexible development process.

text: Public API is authenticated via API keys
quote: The API uses "API keys" to authenticate requests.

text: SDK lets developers embed and customize Activepieces inside their own SaaS product
quote: You can use the SDK to embed and customize Activepieces in your SaaS

text: Built-in MCP server lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables, and test automations via natural language
quote: Activepieces includes a built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables, test automations, and more — all through natural language.

text: Can connect to external MCP servers for systems that aren't native pieces
quote: MCP server An external server, for systems that aren't pieces.

text: Positioned as an open-source replacement for Zapier
quote: An open source replacement for Zapier

text: One-line setup command writes config, generates secrets, and starts the whole stack
quote: One line writes the config, generates your secrets, and starts everything.

text: Move data and update records across 764 prebuilt app integrations without custom glue code
quote: Move data, send messages and update records between 764 apps without writing glue code.

text: A natural-language prompt (e.g. 'summarise my unread emails') generates a drafted AI agent with name, instructions, and tools
quote: Write "summarise my unread emails every morning" and you get a drafted agent — a name, instructions, and the tools it needs

text: Interrupted workflow runs resume from their last checkpoint instead of restarting
quote: Interrupted runs resume from their last checkpoint instead of starting over

text: Audit logs record which agent, app, action, and account performed an operation
quote: open Platform Admin → Security → Audit Logs and you get the agent, the app, the action, the account it used

text: Sensitive projects require a permissioned reviewer to approve publishing a flow
quote: In projects marked as Sensitive, publishing requires review from a user with the PUBLISH_SENSITIVE_FLOW_ACCESS permission.

text: Local development changes are visible in the browser within seconds
quote: See your changes in the browser within 7 seconds.

text: Embedded end-users can connect their automations to AI tools with one click
quote: Let your embedded users connect their automations to AI with one click

text: Describe a job in plain language, give it app access, and an autonomous agent handles incoming work
quote: Write down the job in plain language, give it access to the apps it needs, and it handles the work as it arrives.

text: Deterministic parts of a job can be built as a fixed flow that the agent hands off to
quote: When part of a job has to happen the same way every time, build that part as a flow and hand it over.

text: Platform can be embedded white-label with a flow builder, AI agents, and 760+ integrations inside another product
quote: Put a flow builder, AI agents and 760+ integrations inside your own product, under your own brand.

text: MCP tools attach individual app actions rather than exposing entire apps as tools
quote: You attach individual actions, not whole apps.

text: A flow is composed of a trigger and a sequence of actions
quote: Flow consists of two parts, trigger and actions

text: Draft edits to a flow don't take effect immediately, preserving the currently published version until republished
quote: The changes you make won't work right away to avoid disrupting the flow that's already published.

text: Users can bring their own AI provider keys for AI-powered features
quote: Bring your own AI keys
